repos.name: coollabsio/coolify
repos.description: An open-source, self-hostable PaaS alternative to Vercel, Heroku & Netlify that lets you easily deploy static sites, databases, full-stack applications and 280+ one-click services on your own servers.
repos.one_liner: A self-hostable, open-source PaaS that simplifies infrastructure management for developers.
bullets: Written in PHP with a robust architecture for managing containerized deployments.
Provides a unified dashboard to replace expensive services like Vercel or Heroku.
Supports one-click deployment for databases, full-stack apps, and over 280 services.
Ideal for teams looking to reduce cloud infrastructure costs while maintaining full control.

Critical for building next-generation agentic applications that require visual feedback.
